```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r load-libraries}
library(edgeR)
library(ggplot2)
library(Biostrings)  # For working with FASTA files
```

## Load Count Matrix

```{r load-data}
## Load Count Matrix

# Load the count matrix
data <- read.table("/home/newol210/macknight_oliver/2023_de_novo_6_sample_transcriptome/RSEM.isoform.counts.matrix", 
                   header = TRUE, row.names = 1, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE, comment.char = "#")

# Ensure counts are numeric
counts <- as.matrix(data)

# Define sample name patterns for each group
none_samples <- c(
  "RSEM_sample_1_using_6SampleTranscriptome",
  "RSEM_sample_2_using_6SampleTranscriptome",
  "RSEM_sample_3_using_6SampleTranscriptome",
  "RSEM_sample_4_using_6SampleTranscriptome",
  "RSEM_sample_5_using_6SampleTranscriptome"
)

high_samples <- c(
  "RSEM_sample_6_using_6SampleTranscriptome",
  "RSEM_sample_7_using_6SampleTranscriptome",
  "RSEM_sample_8_using_6SampleTranscriptome",
  "RSEM_sample_9_using_6SampleTranscriptome",
  "RSEM_sample_10_using_6SampleTranscriptome"
)

group_labels <- ifelse(
  colnames(counts) %in% none_samples, "None",
  ifelse(colnames(counts) %in% high_samples, "High", NA)
)

# Subset counts and groups to include only "None" and "High"
valid_groups <- group_labels %in% c("None", "High")
counts <- counts[, valid_groups, drop = FALSE]
groups <- factor(group_labels[valid_groups])
```

## Create DGEList Object

```{r dge-object}
# Create DGEList object
dge <- DGEList(counts = counts, group = groups)

# Filter out lowly expressed genes
keep <- filterByExpr(dge)
dge <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

# Normalize library sizes
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)
```

## Estimate Dispersion

```{r estimate-dispersion}
# Estimate dispersion
dge <- estimateDisp(dge)
```

## Perform Differential Expression Analysis

```{r differential-expression}
# Perform exact test
dge_results <- exactTest(dge, pair = c("None", "High"))

dge_table <- topTags(dge_results, n = Inf)$table
significant_genes <- dge_table[dge_table$FDR < 0.001 & abs(dge_table$logFC) > 1, ]
```

## Plot Results

```{r plot-volcano}
# Volcano plot
volcano_data <- data.frame(
  logFC = dge_table$logFC,
  negLogFDR = -log10(dge_table$FDR),
  Significant = dge_table$FDR < 0.05
)

ggplot(volcano_data, aes(x = logFC, y = negLogFDR, color = Significant)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey", "red")) +
  labs(title = "Volcano Plot", x = "Log2 Fold Change", y = "-Log10(FDR)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Save Results

```{r save-results}
# Save significant genes to file
write.table(significant_genes, "/home/newol210/macknight_oliver/2023_de_novo_6_sample_transcriptome/significant_ISOFORM_RSEM_10_samples_6sampleDeNovo.txt", 
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = TRUE)
```

## Extract Significant Gene Sequences

```{r extract-dna-sequences}
# Load significant gene IDs (from your EdgeR result)
sig_genes <- read.delim("/home/newol210/macknight_oliver/2023_de_novo_6_sample_transcriptome/significant_ISOFORM_RSEM_10_samples_6sampleDeNovo.txt",
                        header = TRUE, row.names = 1)
sig_gene_ids <- rownames(sig_genes)

# Read Trinity fasta
fasta_file <- "/home/newol210/macknight_oliver/2023_de_novo_6_sample_transcriptome/Trinity.fasta"
fasta <- readDNAStringSet(fasta_file)

# Extract clean IDs from FASTA headers (remove anything after first space)
fasta_ids <- sub(" .*", "", names(fasta))  # keep only up to first space

# Extract gene part (remove isoform suffix, e.g. "_i1")
#fasta_gene_ids <- sub("_i[0-9]+$", "", fasta_ids)

# Keep sequences whose gene part matches DE gene IDs
keep <- fasta_ids %in% sig_gene_ids
filtered_fasta <- fasta[keep]

# Optional: check how many matched
cat(sum(keep), "transcripts matched out of", length(fasta), "total\n")

# Save the filtered fasta
output_fasta <- "/home/newol210/macknight_oliver/2023_de_novo_6_sample_transcriptome/filtered_DE_ISOFORMs_low_vs_high.fasta"
writeXStringSet(filtered_fasta, filepath = output_fasta)
```
